title: rDPS Meter
changeNote: 0.1.28 - A card you make for a teammate now pays you. Blade Symphony puts two Shivs in every ally's hand and Largesse hands one ally a colourless card; until now the meter credited every point those cards dealt to the player who happened to be holding them, so a card whose whole purpose is arming the party read as nothing. The damage and the block of a gifted card now go to the player who gave it, while any other teammate's buffs on the same hit keep exactly what they were worth. A card you make for yourself is unchanged, and so is a card that merely draws for a teammate - Plot and Tutor hand over cards the ally already owned. Verified against game v0.111.0; still works on v0.107.1 and later.
